description: This file is a shell script used for testing various scenarios related to Git merge conflict resolution, specifically involving diff3 conflict markers and merge strategies. It sets up multiple Git repositories with different histories and conflicts, runs merge and rebase commands, and checks for proper conflict markers and messages.

methods.name: test_setup_zdiff3
methods.description: A function that initializes a Git repository with specific merge conflicts involving diff3 markers, setting up 'left' and 'right' branches with conflicting changes and committed files.
